resources.string: Optional Firebase usage analytics. Applied on Continue; turn off anytime in Settings.

Google Firebase Analytics receives automatic usage events, device and app details, an installation identifier and IP-derived approximate location to help understand app usage. No custom events are added. Collection starts only if you enable this switch and continue. You can disable analytics in Settings. Advertising choices are separate.
Optional, on-device use. Save applies selections; Allow applies one use. You can skip all.
Limited to apps Android makes visible; no runtime permission to request.
These settings are unavailable on this device. You can continue without this access.
